title: pedicularis cristatella
intro: Pedicularis cristatella, commonly known as Lop host, is a flowering plant species belonging to the family Orobanchaceae. It is a parasitic plant that obtains its nutrients by connecting to the roots of other plants, typically grasses and sedges. Pedicularis cristatella has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to reduce swelling and combat infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant and immunomodulatory effects.
